51:         call.args.retain(|arg| {

56:             let is_unused = unused_arguments.contains(&index);
57:             index += 1;
58:             !is_unused

86:         let mut current_line = start_line;
87:         loop {
88:             reconstructed.push_str(source_view.line_text(current_line));
89:             if current_line == end_line {
90:                 break;
91:             }
92:             current_line = current_line.saturating_add(1);
93:         }
94:         let span_start = source_view.line_start(start_line);
95:         let inner_start = usize::from(start_offset - span_start);
96:         let inner_end = usize::from(end_offset - span_start);

122:                 let referenced = referenced_positions.contains(&argument_index);
123:                 let starred = argument.is_starred_expr();
124:                 let reconstructed_unused = !referenced && !starred;
125:                 let effective_unused = if unused {
126:                     reconstructed_unused || unused
127:                 } else {
128:                     unused && reconstructed_unused
129:                 };
130:                 if effective_unused {

132:                 } else {
133:                     keep_flags.push(true);
134:                 }
135:                 argument_index += 1;
136:             }

166:                                 }
167:                             }

169:                                 if whitespace.first_line.comment.is_some() {

171:                                 } else {
172:                                     kept_args.push(cst_arg);
173:                                 }
174:                             }
175:                         }
176:                     } else {
177:                         kept_args.push(cst_arg);
178:                     }
179:                 }
180:             }
181:             cst_call.args = kept_args;
182:         }

221:         .next()
222:         .context("expected the exception name to be preceded by `as`")?;

224: 
225:     // Lex to the end of the preceding token, which should be the exception value.
226:     let preceding = tokenizer
227:         .next()
228:         .context("expected the exception name to be preceded by a token")?;

230:     // Lex forwards, to the `:` token.
231:     let following = SimpleTokenizer::starts_at(bound_exception.end(), locator.contents())

233:         .next()
